ios.desc:
XTTV is an Apple TV app designed for watching video content from social media like Twitter on the big screen.

With a clean, TV-optimized interface, XTTV lets you discover and play publicly available videos from social media in a comfortable living-room experience. The app focuses on video viewing only, making it easy to browse and enjoy trending and popular video content directly on Apple TV.

XTTV uses data and APIs provided by social media platforms to retrieve video content and related metadata. All videos remain hosted by the respective platforms, and the app acts solely as a viewing client without modifying, storing, or redistributing media.

Features

Watch publicly available videos from social media on Apple TV
Optimized for large screens and remote control navigation
Smooth video playback experience
Simple and distraction-free interface focused on video content

Disclaimer:
XTTV is an independent application and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any social media platforms.

quotes.text:
I noticed that many long videos are posted on Twitter, and sometimes I prefer to watch them on TV, so I build this App, it can sync bookmarks and list(on the way) from Twitter to Apple TV. I use Apple TV usually, so I build for Apple TV first, android tv will be available soon,I need more time to test it.
Twitter's v2 api is too expensive by the way. So please don't sync too much. here is more intro: https://xttv.islasher.com/
